Applied via the §7.1 safe sequence: workflow+policy+tests changed atomically, lint required at every step, no fail-open or never-reporting window.

safe_apply_sequence.detail: Failing tests pin the new job set (lint lightweight, lint-quality full Racket lint); every other job-set pin across the repo updated in the same commit — no orphaned expectations. Workflow, policy and tests change atomically on the campaign branch; lint remains in the required set throughout.

Delivery-contract PR squash-merged to main with the split ci.yml and the extended required-pr-checks.policy. Branch protection still requires the pre-split set; lint is required before, during and after the merge — no fail-open window.
lint-quality runs on main post-merge (never-reporting window closed) and must report success before it can become required.
lint-quality reported green on main (step 3 precondition met), so the protection requirement is added. lint stays required at every step; order is green-before-required.

Both lint and lint-quality confirmed required via the GitHub API; the API snapshot is bound into this checkpoint's branch_protection block. Rollback rehearsal executed in dry-run form and documented in the wave validation record (remove lint-quality requirement first, then restore workflow/policy; lint never leaves the required set; a half-reverted or fail-open state is a release blocker).
